ratio_decidendi.ratio: A state is bound by its own formulated rules and policies for premature release and must apply them strictly, equally, and transparently. The policy applicable to a convict's case is the one in effect on the date of their conviction, unless a subsequent, more beneficial policy has been instituted, in which case the more liberal policy must be applied.
obiter: An arbitrary method adopted by the State is liable to grave abuse and is liable to lead to a situation where persons lacking resources, education and awareness suffer the most.

judicial_reasoning.core_finding: The State, having formulated its own rules and a standing policy for deciding cases of premature release, is legally bound by them. It is not open to the State to adopt an arbitrary yardstick for selecting cases; it must strictly and equally apply the terms of its policies to all persons in an efficient and transparent manner to avoid the grievance of uneven application.
legal_tests_applied: Each case for premature release has to be decided on the basis of the legal position as it stands on the date of the conviction, subject to a more beneficial regime being provided in terms of a subsequent policy determination.
The provisions of the law must be applied equally to all persons.
The State is bound by its own formulations of law and policy.
why_respondent_won: The State is not permitted to adopt an arbitrary yardstick for picking up cases for premature release, as it is bound by the legal provisions and its own standing policy which hold the field.
The State must strictly abide by the terms of its policies and apply them equally, efficiently, and transparently to all similarly circumstanced persons.

The court noted a history of cases being repeatedly brought before it where convicts who fulfilled the eligibility conditions for premature release were not having their cases dealt with in terms of the policy.
policy_considerations: An arbitrary method adopted by the State is liable to grave abuse.
Arbitrary application of policy is liable to lead to a situation where persons lacking resources, education and awareness suffer the most.
State policies must be applied efficiently and transparently so as to obviate the grievance that the policy is being applied unevenly to similarly circumstanced persons.
